performanceEntry.pageIntro: Fill in your sheet at your own pace: only your personal information is to be entered. Performance indices, percentages and charts are calculated by your manager from the evaluations and do not appear here.
performanceEntry.viewIntro: Entry version, without calculation elements or charts. Save to update the full sheet.
performanceEntry.pickPerson: Choose the person whose sheet you want to fill in.
performanceEntry.completionHint: {{filled}} of {{total}} sections contain at least one answer.
performanceEntry.loadFailed: The sheet could not be loaded: the fields below are empty but your existing sheet is not lost. Try again before entering anything.

fields.brings_to_team: What I bring to the team
fields.brings_to_manager: What I bring to my manager
fields.expects_from_team: What I expect from the team
fields.expects_from_manager: What I expect from my manager

performanceEntry.hatHelp: The Bono hat describes your dominant way of thinking in a team.

validation.nothingToSave: Nothing to save: fill in at least one section of your sheet.
validation.duplicate: "{{value}}" appears twice in "{{field}}": keep a single line.
validation.tooLong: A line of "{{field}}" exceeds {{max}} characters. Shorten it.
validation.sinceInvalid: The start date "{{value}}" is invalid: enter a year (2019) or a month (2019-03), between 1950 and today.
validation.sinceWithoutPosition: A start date is filled in without the matching position: enter the previous position or clear the date.
